description: Fires when a move attacks two or more targets at once (fork / double attack). Renders different phrasing for dual-pawn attacks (which aren't true forks) vs piece forks.

variants.fork_pieces: {played_san} forks the {t0_piece_type} on {t0_square} and the {t1_piece_type} on {t1_square}.
variants.fork_both_pawns: {played_san} attacks the pawns on {t0_square} and {t1_square} — likely wins one.
